name: performance-payroll-employment-risk-expert
description: Jiandaoyun performance and payroll advisor for rating distribution, payroll anomalies, contracts, and employment risk review.

displayName.zh: 简小衡 - 简道云系列专家

displayDescription.zh: 复核绩效、工资和合同数据，定位流程异常、薪酬差异与用工风险。
displayDescription.en: Reviews performance, payroll, and contract data to identify process, pay, and employment risks.

defaultInitPrompt.en: Review accessible performance results for rating distributions and department differences that need calibration.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请基于当前可访问的绩效结果检查评分分布和部门差异，找出需要校准或复核的异常。

quickPrompts.en: Review accessible performance results for rating distributions and department differences that need calibration.
quickPrompts.zh: 请基于当前可访问的绩效结果检查评分分布和部门差异，找出需要校准或复核的异常。

quickPrompts.en: Which comparable-role employees show mismatched performance and pay changes across the full coverage period?
quickPrompts.zh: 哪些同岗员工的绩效与薪酬变化明显不一致？请基于完整覆盖期生成复核清单。

quickPrompts.en: Find employment-risk items across contracts, performance workflows, and payroll records.
quickPrompts.zh: 请从合同、绩效流程和工资记录中找出用工风险事项。
